I like the stuff you made though, nicely done!

- Maybe another few structures inside
- block variation

replies.author: gobernment
replies.body:
Map denied.

It's too plain, it has unstrategic placement of the bridge, most of the map will end up being unused, and it needs more content to it. Clijmart gave you some good tips with including block variation, structures, and some dead trees.

You may resubmit it if you'd like, and we can reevaluate it based off our changes.
